# ex_unit_json v0.6.0 - Table of Contents

> AI-friendly JSON test output for ExUnit.
Provides structured JSON output from mix test for use with AI editors like Claude Code.

## Pages

- [ExUnitJSON](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [AGENTS.md - AI Editor Guide](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/agents.md)

## Modules

- [ExUnitJSON](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.md): AI-friendly JSON test output for ExUnit.
- [ExUnitJSON.CompactOutput](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.CompactOutput.md): Compact JSONL output format for ExUnitJSON.
- [ExUnitJSON.Config](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.Config.md): Centralized configuration handling for ExUnitJSON.
- [ExUnitJSON.Coverage](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.Coverage.md): Coverage collection for ExUnitJSON.
- [ExUnitJSON.ErrorGroups](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.ErrorGroups.md): Groups failed tests by similar error messages.
- [ExUnitJSON.Filters](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.Filters.md): Test filtering logic for ExUnitJSON.
- [ExUnitJSON.Formatter](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.Formatter.md): ExUnit formatter that outputs test results as JSON.
- [ExUnitJSON.JSONEncoder](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.JSONEncoder.md): Encodes ExUnit test structures to JSON-serializable maps.
- [ExUnitJSON.Retry](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.Retry.md): Merges a first test run with an automatic retry run to distinguish
*flaky* failures from *confirmed* ones.
- [ExUnitJSON.Trace](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.Trace.md): Opt-in failure-only BEAM message tracing for `mix test.json`.
- [ExUnitJSON.Trace.Recorder](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.Trace.Recorder.md): Per-test tracer process: the "flight recorder" half of message tracing.
- [ExUnitJSON.Trace.Store](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitJSON.Trace.Store.md): Cross-process handoff store for trace data captured by `ExUnitJSON.Trace.Recorder`.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix test.json](https://ex-unit-json.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Test.Json.md): Runs tests and outputs results as JSON.
